मुफ़्त वाई-फ़ाई

9.0

Located in Sydney and within 1.5 km of Central Station Sydney, Surry Hills Budget Hotel - Near Oxford Street features a shared lounge, non-smoking rooms, and free WiFi. The property is set 1.9 km from Hyde Park Barracks Museum, 1.9 km from Art Gallery of New South Wales and 3.4 km from Bondi Junction Station. Australian National Maritime Museum is 3.7 km away and The Star Event Centre is 3.9 km from the inn. The inn provides certain rooms that include a balcony, and each room has a kettle. Guest rooms will provide guests with a toaster. International Convention Centre Sydney is 3.5 km from Surry Hills Budget Hotel - Near Oxford Street, while The Royal Botanic Gardens is 3.6 km away. Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport is 8 km from the property.

Surry Hills Budget Hotel - Near Oxford Street में आपके ठहरने के आधार पर कीमतें अलग-अलग हो सकती हैं (जैसे आपकी चुनी गई तारीखें, होटल की पॉलिसी आदि). अपनी तारीखें दर्ज करके कीमतें देखें.
